global: ODIN is a training reference. Imported assertions have not been independently verified as current service inventories.
Country of origin and operator-filter membership are distinct. Neither supplies an operator-specific service interval.
The flat CSV collapses fields from different sections. It can overwrite repeated names, notes, type and range fields. Raw values must retain their field names and export provenance.
The dateOfIntroduction field can describe a family, prototype or production milestone rather than a specific variant's operational service entry.
A numeric value without a unit is not normalized into a speed, range, mass or capacity.
The Data Only export was attempted but no download event or completed file was observed. CSV exports succeeded. Structured component context requires further source inspection.
